d.ko: Uncover the fate of humanity's final outpost as you survive and explore a thrilling world of floating islands. Brave the skies on your own or assemble a squadron of friends, and scavenge scrap to engineer and upgrade flying vessels, bringing your airship along for the journey.
d.en: Uncover the fate of humanity's final outpost as you survive and explore a thrilling world of floating islands. Brave the skies on your own or assemble a squadron of friends, and scavenge scrap to engineer and upgrade flying vessels, bringing your airship along for the journey.
d.zh: 在这个由浮空岛组成的惊险世界中努力求生并展开探索，揭晓人类最后一个前哨站的命运。你可以独自勇闯天际，也可以与好友组成小队，收集废料来打造和升级飞行器，带上你的飞船一同踏上旅程。
